I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`. That's a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant, so it's easy to tune. At 4 requests per second it stays under the sandbox's 5 per second limit. I haven't run the test, so I haven't confirmed the flake is gone. It's an integration test against the live sandbox, so CI is the real check.

The test only makes four calls, so the sleeps add about a second in total.

I also saved a note about the sandbox rate limit to project memory.
